EPUB.js 0.3.93 (`epubjs/src/epubcfi.js` and its tree-shaken core helpers), BSD-2-Clause.
Regenerate with `node scripts/vendor-gnome-epub.mjs` after installing locked npm dependencies.
The browser's DOMParser replaces the unused Node XML parser fallback. No ZIP,
book loader, browser controls, networking or storage code is included.
